scope: Corollary 15.2 (Two profiles of the input-offset processor) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 76. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On T3, the fixed label P = (1/4, 1/4, 0) and strip O = {1/32 < Y < 1/8} realize halting from zero velocity by two effective mean-zero general forces. One is stationary after time one. The other tends to zero uniformly and has every mixed-derivative spatial supremum norm in L2(0, ∞). Both have bounded mixed derivatives, zero prescribed pressure, uniformly bounded kinetic energy, and uniqueness in the torus comparison class.
